source_instruction: i want to purchase synthetic hair topper that are 18 inch long and have 4 clips of dark blonde hair with bangs.
query: Ugh, my cat knocked over my favorite potted succulent this morning and got soil all over the entryway rug, I spent 20 minutes scrubbing it out before I even remembered I had to pop onto this site. I also realized I forgot to pick up oat milk on my way home yesterday, so my morning coffee was just sad black instant stuff that tasted like burnt cardboard. My neighbor was telling me yesterday how their golden retriever dug up a whole patch of their front yard tulips right after they planted them last weekend. I’ve heard synthetic hair pieces work really well for anyone browsing the hair loss products section, that the 4 clips-dark blonde w style with bangs that’s 18 inches long is super popular, and all the options in that line sit right under $60.
